packMeta.name: CaterCraft (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey catering & event orders hub: visual event pipeline with automatic per-head quote calculation and HTML run-sheets, multi-station kitchen production board, delivery dispatch runs, dietary requirements matrix with kitchen sign-off, menu packages and client directory. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
